item.title: HeyBuds 0.6.3
item.description:
• 未适配的蓝牙耳机和音箱也会显示连接与断开提醒。弹窗使用系统蓝牙名称，macOS 提供可写音量时，可在弹窗或主面板调节该设备的输出音量。 • Galaxy Buds 优先使用耳机公布的型号标识。Buds4 Pro 提供该标识时，改成任意昵称也能识别。
• Bluetooth headphones and speakers without a device profile now show connection and disconnection pop-ups using their system name. Adjust the device’s output volume in the pop-up or main panel when macOS makes it available. • Galaxy Buds now use the advertised model ID when available, so a Buds4 Pro that supplies its ID can be recognized under any nickname.
